research_question: Does pedagogy-specific prompt architecture improve explanatory clarity beyond a frozen baseline, and what incremental benefit is attributable to expressive V3 visuals?

variants.label: frozen LearnFlow prompts + frozen V2 Core
V3 pedagogical prompts + same frozen V2 Core
variants.prompt: V3 research agent sidecar prompt (after future approval)
variants.renderer: SAME frozen V2 Core as A
variants.contract: adapter must map only supported V2 contract fields; unsupported visual intent is recorded as structural failure not erased

variants.label: same V3 pedagogical prompts + separately validated expressive V3 renderer
variants.renderer: V3 checked finite operations guarded by evidence and object identity
variants.contract: pre-specified capabilities only; unsupported paths are failures

frozen_preregistered_heldout_topics.must_have: matrix/vector explicit transformation and invariant axes
valid contingency counts or host exact fractions; prevent base-rate inversion
simulator or analytic host-truth trajectory and continuous object identity
host-derived visited frontier and topological state each step

dataset.exclusion_rule: None of these four exact topic IDs or their specific visual solution templates may be used as in-context exemplars during prompt authoring. Four topics are a feasibility PILOT not enough for statistical claims.
dataset.scale_up_rule: Before any efficacy claim, preregister a disjoint domain-stratified minimum 24 topic inputs (at least 6 per domain) and at least 3 independent human assessors per output. Same inputs across A/B/C; paired order/labels randomized.

inference.temperature: fixed and provider-supported; never add unsupported argument
inference.data_source: identical verified source/evidence ledger per topic
inference.narration: same target audience, duration window, voice renderer, aspect ratio, fps and resolution
inference.computation: identical budget per A/B/C except changes isolated by arm; if compatibility requires retries, count as failures for all arms or stop
inference.seed_and_randomness: record effective seed when supported; if unsupported, record as uncontrolled source of variance
inference.selection: intention-to-treat all runs, including schema rejections, unsupported operation, CI failures and zero-video outputs. No cherry picking.

measurement.hard_safety: 100% verified claims, object identity, no unsupported results, no executing generated Python, no 3b1b borrowed scenes
engineering_primary: valid full MP4 per planned assignment
actual encoded scene Semantic witness visible at registered frame window
measurement.rubric_details: Each rating must include one video timestamp + factual reason; do not infer learner gains from expert preference. Separate learner quizzes only with independent ethics/protocol and participant consent.
measurement.evaluators: at least 3 independent blinded reviewers per output, balance arm order and opaque IDs, measure agreement; no author/self-rating used as confirmatory result
measurement.statistical_plan: paired per-topic B-A and C-B differences on preregistered primary clarity axis; bootstrap 95% CI at TOPIC level, including failures as zero-completion with separate quality missingness. Do not use individual video frames as independent samples. Correct for two confirmatory comparisons.
measurement.practical_min_delta: pre-register >=0.5 / 5-point mean paired clarity improvement and 95% CI lower bound >0 on scaled 24+ topics. Four feasibility cases cannot establish success.
negative_controls: one narrative beat preceding visual evidence
one scene rendering but no semantic visible before/after
measurement.fairness: B vs A isolates prompt given unchanged renderer; C vs B isolates expressive renderer given same prompts. No claim of prompt benefit if B's output is rejected by same frozen adapter.

gate.V356_research_go: 18 direct Read texts, explicit inability to certify full film timelines, sampled matched scene source paths, typed V3 sidecar fields and host validation, no broken V2, unbiased A/B/C protocol, no provider calls
gate.next_checkpoint: V3-57 (proposal) sidecar adapter + frozen B-vs-A feasibility test; paid inference only with separately approved budget. Do not auto-launch.
fail_if: V2 Core or production prompt mutated
scope silently moves source claims into unrestricted transform semantics
A/B/C heldout leak or different provider allowance

ethics_and_rights.license_check: 3b1b/videos CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; conceptual high-level analysis only; no reused scene code or assets
